title: MSA §5.3 monitoring — narrow follow-up on Item 6 of W012297
summary:
A narrow follow-up to Item 6 of W012297-030826: 'any policy, procedure, or system documentation describing how SMPD monitors or tracks vendor-initiated disclosures under §5.3.'

MSA §5.3 lets Flock disclose footage on its own good-faith determination. The relevant record for Item 6 is a policy, procedure, or configuration, not an email. This request scopes Item 6 explicitly to non-email records.

policy_promises.quote: Flock may disclose Customer Data as required to provide the Services
policy_promises.tests: What policy, procedure, or system documentation describes how SMPD would learn of a §5.3 disclosure?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012297 Item 6 was about a policy/procedure/configuration record. This request isolates Item 6 so it can be answered directly, separate from the W012462 email corpus that W012297 was consolidated into.

filed_because: Asks for the specific policy/procedure/configuration record described in W012297 Item 6, scoped to non-email records.
notes:
Parser initially marked 'needs_review' because the request body referenced closure language from an earlier exchange. Status set manually.

A short yes/no response confirming the existence (or absence) of any monitoring record resolves the item.
